# castai_external_connections (Data Source)

Lists all external cloud-account connections for an organization. Supports filtering by cloud provider.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_cloud` (String) Filter connections by cloud provider. Valid values: AWS, AZURE, GCP, ORACLE.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID to list connections for. If not provided, will attempt to infer it using the CAST AI API client.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `items` (List of Object) List of external connections. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
